title: Update expense category and subcategory descriptions
summary: Expense category and subcategory descriptions are clarified to explain what purchases they cover, such as MEALS now covering food and beverages regardless of merchant type.
key_points: MEALS now covers food and beverages for any merchant type
PHARMACY covers health-related products for any merchant type
MISC remains the fallback for unclassified purchases
Descriptions updated consistently across setup and demo data
quote: Align the 12 category/subcategory descriptions for MEALS, PERSONAL, PHARMACY, and MISC with the updated expense classification descriptions supplied for this change.
